purpose: Paired synthetic sensitivity and persistence checks before accepting detector changes; not real holdout validation.
split_policy: Development may guide changes. Run reserved evaluation only after candidate source and config hashes are fixed. Once inspected, those evaluation cases are spent and cannot be called untouched in later cycles.
raycaster_limitations: Round straight tunnel only; no measured material response, motion blur, dual returns, weather or new real route.
The existing raycaster discards hits at or beyond 210 m. This protocol makes no 200-300 m capability claim.
Grade remains zero because the existing generator rotates the floor but not its rails or side benches.
Each stationary sequence has independent range/intensity noise, but repeated geometry and ray angles remain correlated.
The stored compact16 fixture has already lost float precision and is not a raw-versus-quantized comparison. Newly generated paired float frames provide that comparison.
seed_rule: split.seed + sequence_index * 100 + frame_index; positive order shape, distance, lateral, then negative_controls order
placement_rule: Mesh bottom is the explicit synthetic floor_z; target labels and pose come only from generator geometry. No fitted detector track is used to place or score an object.
encoding_pair: same arrays converted by compact_to_compact16, decoded through frame_from_compact

matching.note: A gauge detection must have its nearest distance within tolerance of physical target distance and its centroid inside the yaw-expanded target bounds plus padding. Empty scenes and outside controls have no expected STOP.

report: first matched STOP frame and distance
longest visible miss streak after first STOP

acceptance: Compare candidate with the exact baseline source on identical generated float clouds and quantized pairs; preserve per-frame rows and hashes.
No new false STOP frame or episode on any negative control, in either encoding.

Per positive case and encoding: no fewer target-matched STOP frames, no later first STOP, no longer visible miss streak after confirmation, no loss of sustained status, and no new unmatched STOP frame.
Count invisible-target cases explicitly; do not remove them from the report or turn no-return cases into detector successes.
At least one predeclared target metric must improve to claim detector gain. Passing this synthetic screen cannot replace the raw organizer positive replay and full real negative regression gate.
Frame sequences and runtime measurements do not imply independent statistical trials; no significance estimate or real generalization claim.
reserved_execution: Evaluation split is not generated or run until the root reviewer records candidate hashes and authorizes final evaluation.
